sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables sector underperformed today, but the resilient uptick in US regulated utilities like PCG and XEL signals a flight to stable cash flows. Watch for rotation into defensive staples as ID volatility persists; maintain selective exposure to high-growth sub-segments like hygiene and packaged food.
